title: Paul Mellon's family and support for fascism

tellings.quote: And he said, "Yeah, I mean, he was a huge supporter of Adolf Hitler and fascism. So was Henry Ford. So was Watson of IBM.

plain: In the 1930s and early 1940s, the story goes, Paul Mellon's family was 'a huge supporter of Adolf Hitler and fascism', and so were Henry Ford and Watson of IBM. Steven Greer, a doctor who campaigns for UFO disclosure, tells Michels this second-hand: he says a man named John Warner IV told it to him, and he also names Prescott Bush. If true, it would tie some of America's richest families to fascism.
